name: powerwiki
description: PowerWiki is an Azure DevOps extension that adds a Power Wiki menu experience while continuing to use the standard Azure DevOps Wiki repositories as the source of truth.

scripts.package:vsix: npm run build && npx tfx-cli extension create --manifest-globs vss-extension.json
scripts.package:vsix:dev: npm run build && npm run manifest:dev && npx tfx-cli extension create --manifest-globs vss-extension.dev.json
scripts.package:vsix:canary: npm run build && npm run manifest:canary && npx tfx-cli extension create --manifest-globs vss-extension.canary.json
scripts.publish:marketplace: npm run build && npx tfx-cli extension publish --manifest-globs vss-extension.json
scripts.publish:dev: npm run build && npm run manifest:dev && npx tfx-cli extension publish --manifest-globs vss-extension.dev.json --share-with dataversepowertools
scripts.publish:canary: npm run build && npm run manifest:canary && npx tfx-cli extension publish --manifest-globs vss-extension.canary.json --share-with dataversepowertools
